essence: The beneficiary enjoys enduring fortune together with his household.
Mere knowledge can effect direct identity with Sadāśiva.
The person attains the honored status of Pārvatī's son recognized by all scriptures.
Kamalā, beloved of Viṣṇu, is the goddess to be always served by seekers of knowledge.
Śāṅkarī, invoked with hrīṃ, protects the middle of the eyes and the eye pair.
